औत्तमि m. (-मिः) The third MANU.
 E. उत्तम, and इञ् patronymic. k. aff.

औत्तरपथिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going or coming in a northerly direction.
E. उत्तर, पथ for पथिन् a road, ठक् aff.

औत्तानपादि m. (-दिः) A name of DHRUVA, in mythology the son of
UTTANAPADA, and grandson of the first MANU; in astronomy,
the polar star, or the north pole itself.
 E. उत्तानपाद, and इञ् patro-
nymick aff.
